tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thob pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las chos kyi rje sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pas rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gyi sarga bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sya nā tha dā na kirti nā ma ti shikṣ+ya shī le na sya ru tsi ra ma ma na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo'i mgon po sbyin pa grags pa zhes bya ba'i bslab gsum khrims kyis mdzes pa de la bdag 'dud do/ /sha chang spangs sogs tshul khrims rnam dag cing / /bdag pas gzhan gces 'byongs pa'i sems dpa' che/ /sbyin pa la sogs tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i/ /snyan pa'i grags pa gsal der phyag bgyi 'o/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa chos kyi rje sdom brtson rigs sngags 'chang ba sbyin pa grags pa'i drung du/ dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mnos pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar/ ༈ chos rgyal ma'i 'don thabs su grags pa'i 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sbrags sgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ mkhan chen g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shes bya kun rig kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ chos rje kun dga' chos bzang / rje nor bu phun tshogs/ rje lha dbang blo gros/ chos rje blo gros rab yangs/ chos rje sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /chos rje sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sbrags sgrub kyi yig cha'i lung yang thob/ ༈ /ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dbang byin rlabs zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu ba/ ras chung ba/ mi la ras pa/ dwags po lha rje/ mtha' tsa ba/ 'bri khung pa/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin chen dpal/

rje zur phug pa/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal/ chos rje bde legs rin chen/ kun dga' dpal bzang / dbu ma pa dpal ldan bzang po/ drin can dpal ldan mgon po/ chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na/ rje sangs rin/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ shrī ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na sa lo/ paṇa chen lha dbang blo gros/ nub dgon pa sangs rgyas grags pa/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'og min chen por sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /zag med sgyu mar rdo rje bdag med ma/ /so wa na thar rnal 'byor dbang phyug che/ /u tsa ya nar brtul zhugs nag po pa/ /kan pa gling du grub chen ḍa ma ru/ /mkha' 'gro rdzong du a wa dhu ti pa/ /kha rag thod bur ga ya dha ra'i zhabs/ /mu gu lung du sgra bsgyur 'brog mi rje/ /mkhar chu chu khar se ston kun rig zhabs/ /sag thang ding du zhang ston dgon pa ba/ /kha gdang gnas su bla chen sa skya pa/ /chu mig rdzing khar bla chen bsod nams rtse/ /sgo rum gnas su rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs/ /byang ngos sprul sder sa skya paṇḍi ta/ /lha khang lho ru 'phags pa rin po che/ /skyed 'phrang gnas su zhang ston dkon mchog dpal/ /na bza' brag phug dgon par bsod nams dpal/ /bsam yas dkar por 'gro mgon bsod nams mtshan/ /byang chub rdzong du mtshungs med blo gros brtan/ /shar stod gnas su dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs/ /zhe dgon gong mar grub chen buddha shrī/

/e wam̐ dgon par kun mkhyen kun dga'i mtshan/ /bsam gtan phug tu mus chen sems dpa' che/ /byang chub gling du rje btsun kun dbang pa/ /e wam̐ thar rtser rje btsun dkon mchog 'phel/ /bde ba can du sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs/ /dpal ldan sa skyar 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje/ /e wam̐ gnas su dkon mchog lhun grub mtshan/ /thar pa rtse ru sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhabs/ /yol dgon gnas su blo gros chos 'phags pa/ /mnga' ris dgon par kun dga' lung rigs zhabs/ /dben gnas nags dgon yang rtser sbyin pa grags/ /de yis rjes bzung ngag dbang kun bsod do/ /yang na chos rje sa skya paṇa chen nas/ /spyi mo lung du tshogs bsgom kun dga' dpal/ /nyan po gong mar nyan chen bsod nams brtan/ /dkar po brag tu rin chen seng ge'i zhabs/ /bla ma dpal ldan pa man gong dang 'dra/ /yang na/ mus chen/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ gsum kas rjes su bzung ba dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na mus chen/ kun mkhyen gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na mus chen/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen man 'dra/ yang na/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na/ sems dpa' chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang / glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/

rje kun dga' grol mchog mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho man 'dra/ yang na/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ rje btsun gyi dag ldan/ shar chen gyi dag ldan go sla dang bcas pa'i steng nas tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i bshad bka' rgyas par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa/ ḍombhi he ru ka a la badzra/ dpal ldan nags khrod pa/ garbha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa dza ya shrī/ slob dpon sbyangs dka' zla ba/ de la slob ma'i mchog dpa' bo rdo rje/ seng ge rdo rje/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang gsum las/ 'dir dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/ des lo tsā ba chen po shākya ye shes la gnang / de la 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ se mkhar chung ba kun rig 'khyin lo tsā ba 'od kyi snang ba dang bzhi las/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa chen/ yang na bla ma mnga' ris pa/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ dgra lha 'bar/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ yang na se 'khar chung ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa chen/ 'khyin lo tsā ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa skya pa chen po'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' bab bzhi dang ldan pa'i bla ma sa skya pa chen pos/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ tshul khrims grags/ gtsug tor rgyal po gsum la gnang / de gsum kas rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ des chos rje sa skya pa paṇḍi ta chen po la/ des 'phags pa rin po che la/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/

mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug chos rje grags pa mtha' yas/ mus chen rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na/ ngor chen/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po gnyis ka la/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug pa dang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge de gnyis ka la 'dren mchog ratna wardha/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen/ sa paṇḍi ta/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ rje ratna ni ra bho ṣa man 'dra/ rgyud sde spyi rnam rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i ljon shing / stong thun sa bcad/ rgyud sde'i dum bu/ yab yum gyi bstod pa gnyis/ bdag med bstod pa'i 'grel pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ kye rdor rgyud kyi byung tshul ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun bzang gis mdzad pa/ tshul bzhi'i rnam gzhag glo bo mkhan chen pas mdzad pa/ 'grel pa dag ldan/ dag ldan kha skong / dag ljon lung 'grel shar pas mdzad pa/ brgyud 'debs tshul gsum mdzes rgyan/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi mdzad pa rnams kyi lung thos so/ ༈ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i rjes gnang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ dpal bde/ dri med sbas pa/ ratna badzra/ ratna kirti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ bla ma gnam kha 'ub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sa chen/ rje btsun/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ grags pa tshul khrims/ shes rab rdo rje/ rgyal bzang pa/

mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar pa ye rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa thos/ ༈ /yang bla ma chos kyi rje de nyid kyi drung du/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung chen thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ klu sgrub zhabs/ paṇḍi ta 'bar ba'i gtso/ grub chen zhing gi rdo rje/ rngog lo chen po shes rab grags/ sras slob dpon bha wa/ gtsang ston smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor dbang phyug mdo sde seng ge grub ston shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge lce btsun bsod nams dpal/ sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje/ de'i sras rdo rje seng ge de'i sras rin chen seng ge de'i sras shākya seng ge lce btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ 'di ni phyag rdor gtum chen lha nyer gcig gi dbang gi brgyud pa bzhin bris pa yin la/ rjes gnang rkyang pa'i brgyud pa zhig da dung btsal bar bya'o/ /'di'i gong gi brgyud pa 'ga' zhig brtag des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang chu srung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa mched/ ba ri ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun bsod rtse/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje paṇḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen ye rgyal/ ngor chen kun bzang / rgyal tshab kun dbang / 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/

rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs yon tan khris mdzad pa'i gsal byed yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa la sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi sgom tshul bogs 'don sdigs mdzub kyi sbyor ba/ leb rgan dar gyi sbyor ba/ bsnyen sgrub kyi bar chad bsal ba/ grib sel/ rtsod pa las rgyal thabs kyi las tshogs rnams kyi yi ge'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mi g.yo ba/ 'od byed 'byung gnas dpal/ kha che paṇa chen dā la shi la/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ 'dul 'dzin byang sems pa/ rgyal tsha chos dbang ba/ rgyal tsha gzhon nu grags/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ g.yag ston sangs rgyas dpal ba/ rong ston shes bya kun rig paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ shrī ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /dā na shī las mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / sgrub thabs bstod pa sogs mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa rnams kyi lung yang thos so/ ༈ /ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa/ de la brten nas grong khyer du rims nad gcod pa'i man ngag dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ shar pa sku mched/ ngor chen/ mus chen/

kun mkhyen/ bla ma ri khrod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ dam pa rgya gar ba/ kha che gu hya pa/ rlan bsgom yab sras/ slob dpon 'od shāka pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ skyi ston/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen kun bzang / paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje blo gros chos 'phags/ rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge dmar po'i rigs gtad thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ dhī ra pā la/ rngog lo blo ldan/ khyung ston rin chen grags/ rgya dmar dbang phyug grags pa chos kyi seṅge / gtsang nag brtson 'grus seṅge / dan bag dar seng / gnyal zhig 'jam rdor/ zad pa dar tshul/ dge bshes gra thang pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yang rtsen rin chen seṅge / bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen rin rnam pa/ bla ma bkras rin/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seṅge/ rje blo gros chos grags/ rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum phal cher gyi lung thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ chos rje sangs rgyas seṅge / rje kun dga' lung rigs/

rje nags dgon pa/ sbyin pa grags/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang chos kyi rje de nyid kyi drung du/ bla ma chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa/ shar chen la bstod pa lnga/ grub chen buddha shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ mkhan chen bkra shis rin chen/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rje sa skya pa chen po rnams la bstod pa/ sdom gsum bla ma brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba/ lam zab brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi kha skong / lam 'bras/ bsam mi khyab/ lhan cig skyes grub/ mchod rten drung thob/ yi ge med pa/ padma badzra'i lam/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po bsrang ba/ ind+ra bhu ti'i lam/ bde mchog rim lnga/ rtsa dbu ma'i ring brgyud/ bde mchog dkar po/ mahā ma ya'i spros med/ gsang 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs/ ra rtse sems 'dzin/ shin tu spros med/ spyod 'jug zhen pa bzhi bral rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ shes phyin dkar mo/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil chog 'dod rgyal/ tshogs bdag 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil chog gtsug tor/ nor rgyun ma'i dkyil chog gi cho ga sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga sa skya paṇḍi ta/ grub chen buddha shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa rnams kyi rnam thar/ gsan yig chen mo/ lam 'bras chos 'byung rtsom 'phro/ bshad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ zhus lan gsang ba'i sa bcad/ dbang bzhi'i rtogs bskyed/ mngon rtogs tshul bzhi'i sdom tshig phyi nang gi bskyed rim dbang dang bcas pa'i sdom tshig nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bir bsrung bar chad kun sel/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris/ bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ de'i nyams len/ de dang lam 'bras mtshan mtshon sbyar ba/ bir bsrung gsar ma/

lus dkyil rtsod spong che chung / rgyud gsum gnod 'joms rtsa 'grel/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa mtshams bshad pa/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi byung tshul dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ brtag gnyis kyi 'gyur chad bsabs pa shlau ka gnyis/ brtag gnyis 'grel pa'i dkar chag kyai rdor ḍombhi lugs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phrin yig dbang po'i rdo rje/ gzhal yas khang gi tshad rnam par bzhag pa/ 'phar ma gnyis kyi don bshad pa/ mtsho skyes dang ḍombhi lugs kyi tho yig sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don/ bstod pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi maṇḍal mchod chog bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/ gtor chog gi 'grel pa/ 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ shes phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi sbyin sreg gar gyi shan 'byed/ sangs rgyas kyi gar/ phyogs bzhi gtor ma'i btang thabs/ chos skyong gi man ngag rnams kyi dkar chag mgon rkyang gi sgrub thabs rgyud 'grel las phyung ba/ lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal/ gtor sgrub kyi man ngag thugs dam bskangs pa'i cho ga kyai rdor bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ sambhu ṭa rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog mchod phreng / dkyil chog sbyin sreg bkra shis/ tshogs 'khor gsang ba kun rgyan/ tshogs 'khor kun bzang rnam rol/ bde mchog bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bde mchog pho brang gi rnam gzhag ril bu la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang / bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje lha mo'i tshe sgrub/ la wa pa bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs kyi tho/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs kyi tho/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sgrub thabs/ sngags phreng mchan ma/

dkyil chog mchod phreng / gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs/ shin tu rnal 'byor gyi khyad par/ gtor chog mchod phreng / rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog dkyil chog sbyin sreg rab gnas/ bkra shis/ rdo rje phreng ba'i sa bzung gi cho ga dgra nag gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i char 'bebs/ 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dag pa/ sgrub thabs kyi lung sbyor/ dkyil mchog spros med mdzes rgyan/ kun rig dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan phan mtha' yas rdul tshon kha skong / cha gsum gtor ma/ dkyil 'khor sgo sbrags kyi bshad pa/ spyod rgyud spyi rnam/ bya rgyud spyi rnam/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes 'dzin/ 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil chog dri med lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / 'od dpag med kyi tshe sgrub/ seng ge sgra/ sna tshogs yum/ rma bya chen mo/ so sor 'brang ma/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ rta mgrin rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ sman bla'i mchod chog sems bskyed rang gis blang pa'i cho ga mchod sbyin chen po'i zin bris/ gtor chen gyi lhan thabs/ gser sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sngags la zhus dag mdzad pa/ rags sdom bcu'i 'bru 'grel/ bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mdor bsdus shig rdo rje theg pa'i bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mtshan nyid bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rje btsun gong ma gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag rang gi grwa sa spyi la gdams pa/ sa bzang pa bsod nams dpal/ lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal/ dge 'dun mgon/ a mo gha/ bla chen chos rin pa/ gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon sa bzang / dbu ma pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ mdo stod pa dge bzang rnams kyi dris lan/ sde snod 'dzin pa ratna shrī la gdams pa/

gsang sngags pa kun dga' gzhon nu la gdams pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gdams pa gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams rin chen la gdams pa shlau ka gcig rgya rong pa bkra shis dpal la gdams pa/ sgrub pa po blo bzang la gdams pa gnyis/ nyag re sangs grags la gdams pa/ paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen la springs pa/ bal yul ye rang gi paṇḍi ta shrī ma no bo dhi yab sras la springs pa/ dpon po rgyal mtshan dpal yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa/ ya tshe rgyal po hasti rā dza yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa/ de'i blon po la gdams pa'i shlau ka gcig a ya dbang phyug bkra shis la gdams pa/ dpon rgan thar pa ye shes la gdams pa/ slob dpon bzod chen la bstod pa/ phyi nang gi yas gtam/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam/ gser 'od dam pa las btus pa'i smon lam/ der ma thus pa chos rje shar pa'i rnam thar/ mngon byang gi bshad pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i rnam bshad/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi spyi rnam rtsom 'phro/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ bka' shog thor bu ba kha yar rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po/ shrī dharmā swa mi/ bi kṣu ku sa li pa las kyang zhib tu thos so/ ༈ /yang mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi bka' 'bum dkar chag nang bzhin thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa grub mtha' shan 'byed cung zad dang bcas pa/

yang lam 'bras bla brgyud gcig sa chen yab sras gsum gyi bstod pa re re/ yang rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo la bstod pa/ sa paṇa gyi bstod pa gnyis/ phan mdzad ma/ 'phags pa'i bstod pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang la bstod pa/ rgyal tshab dam pa la bstod pa tshan pa gsum/ kun mkhyen la bstod pa/ 'dren mchog la bstod pa gnyis/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa gsum/ phur pa'i brgyud rim/ chos rje yon tan chos rgyal la bstod pa/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang la bstod pa gnyis/ chos rje dpal ldan pa la bstod pa/ chos rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la bstod pa gnyis/ mkhyen brtse ma rgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la bstod pa/ chos rje dbang phyug grub pa la bstod pa/ rje thugs rje dpal bzang la bstod pa/ chos rje mgon po dbang phyug la bstod pa/ bde legs rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ bshes gnyen dam pa rab brtan bzang po la bstod pa/ bla ma kun brtson pa la bstod pa/ chos rje gang ba bzang po la bstod pa/ mkhan chen dkon mchog chos skyabs la bstod pa/ bla ma tshul khrims dpal la bstod pa/ rab 'byams pa rgyal rin la bstod pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la bstod pa/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lha tshogs la bstod pa/ sher phyin dkar mo la bstod pa/ khro phu dang dga' ba gdong gi byams pa la bstod pa/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bstod pa dngos grub kyi pho nya bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu stsol ba/ thugs rje rgyun ldan ma/ 'o mtsho ma/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bsdus don/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ sogs sgrol ma'i bstod pa/ gaṇḍi'i bstod pa/ e wam̐ gi bkod pa'i bstod pa/ sgo rum gyi mgon po'i bstod pa/ yang mgon po'i bstod pa gcig rnam sras la bstod pa/ skye rabs kyi phreng ba tshigs su bcad pa/ bsam 'grub gling gi logs ris la bstod pa/

rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'dra la bstod pa/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod la bstod pa/ lam 'bras bla brgyud kyi bris yig rgyal tshab dam pa'i thugs dam bris yig yin thang la zhib tu gzigs pa'i bris yig rgyal tshab dam pa'i rnam thar/ mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ge'i rnam thar/ chos rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rje nyid kyi rnam thar zhus lan ma/ chos rje shar pa'i gdung brgyud kyi byon tshul/ spyi rnam gsal byed/ ljon shing gsal byed/ 'og ma'i stug po bkod pa'i rgyan/ gnod sbyin kha pa ra'i lo rgyus/ mngon par rtogs pa'i tho yig chos sna so dgu'i grangs 'dren tshul/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi sngon du gsungs pa'i gsung rgyun/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi 'chad thabs/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i sa bcad/ mahā ma ya'i bsdus don/ rtog pa bdun pa'i bsdus don/ rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa che ba'i bsdus don/ rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkar chag rnal 'byor ma yi bkra shis/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don/ kyai rdor mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ phur pa'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil chog mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa'i dka' gnas bsdus pa/ 'jigs byed bcu bdun ma/ la wa pa/ bong zhal can/ drag po sgrol dbang / dgra gdong / 'khor chen/ gdong drug rnams kyi dbang gi tho re re/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ spros med kyi khrid yig gdugs dkar can gyi mngon rtogs/ phyir bzlog so 'brang gi mngon rtogs/ gdugs dkar can/ tshe dpag med/ gza' yum/ kyai rdor nag po pa rnams kyi dbang gi tho re re/ gdugs dkar can gyi gtor chog bsrung ba lnga yi dbang tho/ 'od zer can gyi dbang tho/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom thabs chung ba/ don zhags dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang / chab gtor gyi tho/ so 'brang gi rjes gnang gi tho/

seng ge sgra'i gdon 'grol/ mchod rten bsgrub pa'i tho/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs nyin zhi mtshan khro'i 'don thabs/ sgrol ma gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs/ dug sel ma yi sgrub thabs/ rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang byed tshul/ phyag rdor u tsarya'i mngon rtogs bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ u tsa'i rjes gnang / phyag rdor 'gro bzang lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ phyag rdor gyi mngon rtogs 'bring po/ rnam sras kyi rjes gnang / rnam 'joms/ ma ṇi badzra gyi gtor 'bum/ phyag rdor gtum po'i sgom bzlas/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang / mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs/ sha wa ri'i rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang / gang blo ma'i rjes gnang / sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ gur nas gsungs pa'i khro bcu'i gtor 'bul/ 'khor lo bri tshul/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gur gyi mgon po'i mngon rtogs/ gtor ma brgya rtsa byed tshul/ bsnyen pa kha gso byed tshul/ rta mgrin gyi gtor 'bul/ kyai rdor zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'phags pa za ma tog gi snying po/ zhib mo rnam dag nor bu chu shel/ yul chen so bdun gyi ngos 'dzin 'khrul med gsal ba/ tsa ri dang de wi ko ṭa'i dgag sgrub/ bde gshegs snying po'i gsal byed/ sdom pa sgrag bzung gi 'thad kyi gsung rgyun/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga yas gtam rin chen rnam spel/ rig gter gyi nyer mkho mtha' gnyis gsal ba/ 'grel bshad rig pa'i 'jug sgo phyogs snga bshad pa'i rigs lam gsal byed/ chos rje rnam rgyal gyi dris lan snga phyi gsum/ slob dpon yon tan 'byung gnas kyi gnas gsum gsal byed las 'phros pa'i dris lan/ dris lan don gsum gsal byed/ byang pa mchod gnas kyi dris lan/

'tsho byed chos skyong dpal bzang gi dris lan/ mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan gsum/ kun dga' dpal bzang grogs mched kyi dris lan/ rje nyid kyis zha lu lo tsā ba la dri ba mdzad pa/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba la springs pa/ dge slong dpal ldan grags la springs yig gnyis/ rin po che'i bstan bcos/ bla ma dpal skyabs la gnang ba'i blo sbyong / rgyal sras lam bzang gi 'chad thabs gnyis/ de yi mdo bshad rin po che'i gter sgrung 'grel/ chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad snying po don gsal/ pha rol phyin pa'i sa lam gyi rnam gzhag bslab btus kyi le 'grel/ sgom rim bar ma'i sa bcad/ yum gyi 'grel rkang / mdo kun las btus pa'i sa bcad/ sa paṇa la zhu 'phrin du gsol ba/ rje nyid kyi thugs la 'khrungs pa'i tshigs bcad/ mi la'i bzhed bkod 'khrul med gnang ba/ rang la bskul ba'i tshig zur brgyad pa/ rab 'byams pa ye shes dbang phyug grogs mched kyi zhus lan/ bdag po chos rgyal nor bu la gdams pa gsum/ mi dbang bkra shis mgon la phul ba/ a seng rdo rje brtan pa la phul ba snga phyi bdun/ mnga' bdag grags pa rgyal mtshan la phul ba/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi gdung rgyud gu ge thar po la phul ba gnyis/ bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams la phul ba zhus lan cung zad dang bcas pa/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang / bla ma dpal skyabs la gdams pa re re/ drung blo ba la gdams pa bzhi/ yid 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad/ rdo rje 'dzin dbyangs las btus pa/ a seng la phul ba gnyis/ rje'i mdzad 'phrin gyi mchod brjod/ bla ma bzang po ba la gdams pa/ yang dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod brjod/ chos rgyal bkra shis mgon gyi dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod brjod/ bstan rtsis dang bcas pa/ yang de nyid kyis dpal ldan sa skyar bsgrubs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod brjod/ gur rgyal gyi brgyad stong pa'i dkar chag a seng rdo rje brtan pa'i mdo mang gi dkar chag

mi'i dbang po bde legs rgya mtsho'i brgyad stong pa yi mtshon byed/ dbu dum brtag gnyis kyi mtshon byed/ bdag mo sangs rgyas sgron gyi gdung chos brgyad stong pa'i mtshon byed/ thub chen gyi 'phan gyi mtshon byed/ rma bya chen mo'i ri'i sdom/ bsam 'grub gling / ngam ring / yang bsam 'grub gling gi lam 'bras/ yang ngam ring / khro phu byams pa rnams kyi 'phan gyi tshigs bcad re re/ bsam 'grub gling gser khang gi dkar chag brgyad stong pa gsum 'bigs kyi dkar chag dpon po khro bo'i brgyad stong pa'i mtshon byed/ chos zom 'du khang gi lha tshogs kyi dkar chag dpon po tshe bzang gi shes phyin stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i mtshon byed/ phun tshogs bsam gtan gling pa'i gser khang dkar chag bla ma skye rtsa pas sa skya bka' 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ yang lam 'bras bla brgyud/ spros med bla brgyud/ lam zab bla brgyud rnams kyi mtshon byed/ sangs rgyas skyabs pa'i mdo mang dkar chag nang so dpal bsrung gi brgyad rtog gser gsum gyi mtshon byed/ lo gsar pa'i dus su phul ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ mkhar spe rab 'byams pa blo gros rab gsal gyi dris lan/ bdag chen chos rje'i dris lan/ dpyal pa'i phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs mtshan brjod 'don thabs/ rigs gsum spyi yi dbang gi tho/ rnal 'byor ma yi byin rlabs kyi tho/ bdag chen ngag pa'i bsnyen pa'i zhus lan/ kun rig gi bsnyen pa byed tshul/ der ma thus pa la brgal lan tshig don mun sel/ bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye'i dris lan lung gi tshad ma/ mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo'i rnam par bshad pa rig gnas gsal byed/ bla ma dmar chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar/ grub ston yon tan dpal dang / la ru ba bsod nams seng ge'i rnam thar sogs bka' 'bum dkar chag nang bzhin thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/

chos rje blo gros bzang po/ rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na chos rje blo gros bzang po/ rje thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dharmā ba/ ma ho padhya ya/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i bstan pa spyi'i chos 'byung chen mo/ rang gi slob ma la gdams pa'i bu ston snying thur/ rgyud sde spyi rnam chen mo rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ bla ma chos dpal/ mkhas pa tsand+ra pa/ rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab rje/ chos rje rin chen rgyal po/ bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan/ rje byang gling pa/ rje kun dga' lung rigs/ sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na rje byang gling pa'i rjes su/ thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ bikṣu paṇḍai pa dharmā swa mi las kyang zhib tu mnos so/ /'dir smras pa/ sardha shwa ra dā na kirti ya na ma/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sbyin pa grags la 'dud/ /a haṃ te pra pā do da dha/ bdag kyang khyed kyi bka' drin chu gter las/ /ryu ba nārdza sa dā dza ra/ lang tsho'i 'dam skyes nam yang ma rgud cing / /sha gandhasatra s+ha bha ṣa tu/ legs bshad dri bsung pad tshal khyab pa lags/ /slar yang sbyin sogs thun mong nyams len dang / /rmad byung sngags kyi lam gyis rang gi rgyud/ /grol nas grags pa gsal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin gsung gi 'phrin las spel bar shog /sbyin bya dbang bzhi rgyud pa rnam dag las/ /legs 'ongs smin grol nyams len mthar phyin cing / /snyan par rab grags skyes bu dam pa yi/ /rnam thar 'dzin pa khyed 'drar bdag gyur cig

/chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thos pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las/ rje nags dgon pa sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pa'i zhal snga nas rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te bdun pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 16 a myes zhabs/ chos kyi rje sdom brtson dam pa sbyin pa grags pas rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gyi sarga/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 15
